summary.headline: Update ring settings table converted to prose sections
summary.summary: The article removes its Setting, Description, and CSP Reference table and begins converting Microsoft product updates guidance to a section-based layout.
summary.adminImpact: Use the revised section-based reference when choosing ring settings.

summary.headline: Update settings heading promoted
summary.summary: The Update settings heading changes from level three to level two while the former settings table is removed.

summary.headline: Compatibility reports prerequisites section removed
summary.summary: The article removes its Prerequisites and Licensing headings during requirements-content consolidation.
summary.adminImpact: Refer to current compatibility report requirements before using the reports.

summary.headline: Update ring reference whitespace adjusted
summary.summary: Only blank lines were added to the update rings policy settings article.

summary.headline: Update rings overview separates timing guidance
summary.summary: The article removes wording that update rings shape installation timing and removes the direct link to the policy settings reference from the creation step.
summary.adminImpact: Consult the current policy reference for detailed setting selection.

summary.headline: Enrollment Status Page monthly quality update capability available January 13
summary.summary: The What's New entry replaces a delay notice with availability beginning January 13, 2026 and identifies the 2026-01 B quality update as the first offered update.
summary.adminImpact: Test the Enrollment Status Page monthly quality update behavior using the January 2026 B release.

summary.headline: Update ring settings reference dated January 12
summary.summary: The article date is updated from July 15, 2024 to January 12, 2026 and the Microsoft product update setting is reformatted.

summary.headline: Feature update deferral range made explicit
summary.summary: The reference now states that feature update deferrals can be set from 0 to 365 days and adjusts prerelease build formatting.
summary.adminImpact: Set a value within the documented 0–365 day range when using feature deferrals.

summary.headline: Deadline settings subsection removed
summary.summary: The article removes the Use deadline settings heading and its statement that deadline settings can be configured.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current update ring setting sections for deadline configuration guidance.

summary.headline: Update ring reports article removes portal navigation and sample image
summary.summary: The report introduction retains the deployment and status description but removes the detailed Intune navigation path and default-policy screenshot.
summary.adminImpact: Navigate through the current Windows updates reporting experience to open an update ring policy report.
